item.title: Resurfacing CHAOS Innsworth Lane, 2nd July
item.description:
I have reported problems all week. Today, the contractors failed to provide access to Little Normans from Innsworth Lane, THEN, their machine broke down, blocking the whole road. Traffic queued back for 200 metres along Brionne Way. There is NO emergency contact sign, diversions signs point the wrong way! Someone from Highways needs to VISIT this site and rectify the problems. I shall be sending a copy of this proforma to the local County Councillor. The situation is ludicrous.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Innsworth Lane, Longlevens, Gloucester
Report on FixMyStreet
